title: Adhkar
description: Beautiful Islamic prayers are sent to you periodically in the chat.
body: **Adhkar Mod** is a lightweight Minecraft mod that periodically sends Islamic remembrances (adhkar) to players in chat. It helps create a calm and mindful atmosphere by reminding players of simple daily dhikr such as *SubhanAllah*, *Alhamdulillah*, and more. > 💡 **For the best Arabic text appearance, it is recommended to use:** > **[Arabic Clean Font (32x)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/arabic-clean-font)** ### Features * Automatic adhkar messages at configurable intervals * Multi-language support (Arabic & English) * Random selection of adhkar * Fully customizable via JSON config file * Per-player language preference * Reload configuration without restarting the server or leaving the world * Works in singleplayer worlds (no server required) ### Commands * `/adhkar` → Send a random dhikr * `/adhkar help` → Show help menu * `/adhkar reload` → Reload config file * `/adhkar ar` → Set Arabic * `/adhkar en` → Set English ### Configuration The config file is automatically generated at: `config/adhkar/adhkar.json` You can: * **Add new adhkar:** Open the config file and add a new entry inside `"adhkar"`: ```json { "ar": "Subhan Allah", "en": "Glory be to Allah" } ``` Make sure commas are placed correctly, then save the file and use `/adhkar reload` to apply changes without restarting. * Edit text and translations * Change the interval timing ### Compatibility * ✔ Server-side compatible (clients do NOT need to install the mod) * ✔ Works in singleplayer worlds * ✔ Compatible with servers * ✔ Lightweight with minimal performance impact
